sections.questions:
Good questions. Clearer next steps.

Before your
next move.

Have a specific question?
Talk to the Blu team

Who does Blu work with?

Businesses seeking growth, especially manufacturing and transportation operations.

What are the application requirements?

We generally look for two years of operations and a sound credit history, but can review individual circumstances when these criteria are not met.

How long does the review take?

We review complete applications for pre-approval within 24 hours after receiving all requested information. Timing depends on the application and is not a funding guarantee.

How long does the application take?

Our online application takes about five minutes. Start your application

Which financing option should I explore?

Use the business-needs guide above to find a starting point. Then discuss your goal, timing, and financial situation with Blu’s team to understand the available options.

What should I prepare for a conversation?

Be ready to describe your business, the amount and purpose of financing, and your preferred timeline. Ask the team which documents are required for the product you’re considering.

How do I learn about rates and fees?

Request a breakdown of pricing, repayment or collection arrangements, fees, and other conditions for your proposed financing. Review the written terms before making a decision.

Can I speak to someone about a cross-border business?

Yes. We serve businesses operating in the U.S., Mexico, or both. Contact the team to discuss your particular operation and financing needs.

products.name: Invoice factoring
products.description: Finance selected outstanding invoices rather than committing every invoice. We focus on customer credit and the business model, including when your own credit score is lower. Submit your invoices for review. Approved invoices may be funded the same day or within 24 hours, subject to processing and agreed terms. There is no minimum invoice quota; our team can explain the requirements.

products.name: Small business line
products.description: A revolving line for a defined business growth plan, payroll, inventory, or purchase orders. Interest is calculated on the amount in use. Draws and payment dates are arranged around your plans and operating cycle, so the entire line may not be available at once.

products.name: Equipment financing
products.description: Financing for equipment, vehicles, expansion, inventory, and other business investments or operating needs. Financing amounts range from $20,000 to $10 million, depending on financial circumstances, with fixed monthly payments for up to 36 months. Collateral is often not required. The product is not for starting a company or personal expenses.

products.name: Short-term lending
products.description: Funding for businesses with consistent cash flow, including refinancing expensive debt. We offer fixed weekly or monthly payments without taking a percentage of sales or requiring property collateral. Financing amounts are $20,000 to $1 million, based on financial review, with terms up to 36 months. Payments can be arranged through direct deposit.

products.name: Purchase order advance
products.description: Finance materials or goods needed for confirmed orders, with payments made directly to suppliers. Designed for manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, and import/export businesses. Materials serve as collateral rather than property. The buyer’s business credit matters even if your own score is low. Your advance may be available within 24 hours, subject to review and processing.

products.name: Reverse factoring
products.description: We pay suppliers earlier, potentially from day one, and your business repays Blu plus a fee at the agreed normal payment date. Earlier supplier payment may support better pricing, additional supplier options, and stronger relationships while helping your cash flow.
